promoted.reason: Independent acceptance, risk-based verification, exploratory/E2E/regression evidence, defect characterization, and readiness verdicts form a recurring ownership layer distinct from implementation, design, security, and release promotion.

Repeated cross-project work needs an independent owner for Cloudflare product selection/composition, bindings/configuration, edge/network topology, and provider-native operational semantics while cross-cutting implementation/security/release/data/QA ownership remains separate.

Schema invariants, indexes/access paths, query plans, transaction/isolation/locking behavior, migration safety, connection semantics, and engine-specific concurrency form a recurring ownership layer distinct from application implementation, record reconciliation, provider setup, release promotion, and independent QA.
